# MealFind

> A free UK meal-planning app that prices whole recipes rather than single
> products. Plan a week of meals, see what each recipe costs at Tesco,
> Sainsbury's and ASDA, and shop from one consolidated list. Currently in beta
> on iOS and Android.

MealFind is built by two university students. The product combines four things
most apps keep separate: recipe discovery, weekly meal planning, live UK
supermarket price comparison, and nutrition tracking.

Prices and nutrition figures shown in the app are estimates. Retailer pricing,
promotions and availability change without notice, so figures should be
verified before purchase.
